QuestInfo.1: The Edelstein #bdoctor#k says that the citizens already know that you're a Cygnus Knight. Continue your discussions.
QuestInfo.2: You talked to the Edelstein #bdoctor#k. It's too late for you to hide your identity from the citizens.

0.0:
Answer just one question for me. You told Ulrika that you weren't a Cygnus Knight, but can you look me in the eye and honestly say you aren't one?
#L0##b(Lie) W-what are you talking about? I'm not a Cygnus Knight!#l
#L1#(Be Honest) Yes, I am a Cygnus Knight.#l
#k
0.1: Ugh, it's just like a Cygnus Knight to lie. Don't think you can fool us that easily.

yes.0: Just as we all already knew. You knights don't understand our circumstances. While the #bBlack Wings#k are around, we have to be ultra vigilant. Lies and secrets on your part only lead to unnecessary complications! \r\nWhy are the knights here? Are you gathering intel?

1.0: You are free to investigate all you wish, but give up on trying to befriend us. We will not forgive so quickly. And forget about trying to infiltrate the #bResistance#k. They will never trust you. I'm warning you, as someone concerned about your health, leave before you hurt yourself.\r\n#L0##bBut we have a common enemy!#l\n#k
1.1: Hush! This is exactly what I'm talking about! The Black Wings are listening, and you knights will only make things worse for us!

yes.0: You refused to help us when we needed you, so we don't need your help now. \r\nGo away.
